messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] metering: sudden token-count divergence detected for multiple emitter partitions in us-east-1. metric: token_delta_pct > 6% for last 5m, affected: ~120 customers. incident created 7144441234. severity=P2.
morgan: acked. I'm oncall — grabbing initial logs and paging billing-eng.
samir: looking. first pass looks like emitter retry storms + delayed kafka consumer commits. seeing duplicate replays from emitter-42 around 7144439000-7144440000.
ryan: can you paste the log snippet?
samir: sure — short snippet below.
```
WARN metering/emit.go: duplicate-emit detected emitter=emitter-42 partition=7 seq=29845 tokens=5120 window=60s
ERROR kafka/consumer.go: commit-lag > 30s consumer=consumer-7 offset=142334 last-processed=142100
```
elaine: if commits lagged then replay of in-flight messages could double-count. are we seeing duplicated ledger entries?
billing-eng: confirmed — shadow ledger shows ~3.9k duplicated token events for org ZoomerLabs (org-783). overage flag already triggered for some accounts.
customer-success: heads-up — CS queue has 2 inbound tickets from enterprise customers reporting unexpected spikes in usage/billing alerts. not yet widespread but a few high-value accounts impacted.
morgan: mitigation options: 1) suppress real-time overage notifications temporarily, 2) enable de-duplication pass on recent window, 3) hold off billing finalize for affected window. thoughts?
samir: priority: stop further duplicate ingestion. ops-oncall can we throttle emitter-42 or flip emitter retry backoff?
ops-oncall: we can pause emitter-42 via the admin toggle. running: `curl -XPOST https://ops.internal/api/v1/emitters/emitter-42/pause -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`
ryan: doing pause now.
ops-oncall: paused emitter-42. verified no new duplicate patterns in the last 30s.
morgan: good. next: run a de-dup job on the shadow ledger and mark duplicates as suppressed for billing compute. samir, billing-eng — can you run the de-dupe?
samir: kicking off de-dupe job (job id dupe-2026-03-17-01). ETA ~6m for initial pass. Will produce a reconciliation delta.
billing-eng: note: we should also hold invoices for windows 7144438000-7144441000 until reconciliation completes. don't want to send incorrect invoices.
customer-success: please flag impacted accounts for proactive outreach. I'll prepare templated outreach for enterprise customers and legal-sensitive accounts.
morgan: I'll open an incident ticket and add postmortem checklist. action list: pause emitter, run de-dupe, hold invoices, credit impacted customers if delta > $50, update CS templates. anyone object?
elaine: no objections. I'll take the next on-call handoff for the live mitigation — give me context and runbook pointers.
morgan: handing off to @elaine for live mitigation. key runbook pointers: where to find shadow ledger (`/var/lib/metering/shadow/`), de-dupe job launcher `/usr/local/bin/dupe-scrub --window 7144438000-7144441000`, billing hold flag: `POST /billing/admin/hold?window=7144438000-7144441000`.
elaine: got it. will monitor de-dupe job and confirm reconcile delta. please also grant me billing-admin for the hold call (I don't have it yet).
billing-eng: granted billing-admin to elaine.
samir: de-dupe initial pass complete. results: removed 4,120 duplicate token events across 117 orgs. net token delta: -1.38M tokens.
morgan: thanks — timeline so far: pause at 7144441030, de-dupe done at 7144441400. next: compute billing delta and decide credits.
billing-eng: running finalize-reconcile now, ETA 10m. will post CSV with per-org deltas.
customer-success: prepping outreach for top 10 impacted orgs. will hold templated message pending final deltas.
ops-oncall: unpause scheduled only after we confirm system stability and consumer commit health. suggest leaving paused for 20m post-de-dupe to ensure no backpressure replays.
elaine: agreed. monitoring consumer offsets — they are catching up, commit lag reduced to <2s.
billing-eng: reconcile complete — attaching summary (pasted below).
```
CSV SUMMARY
org, org_id, tokens_removed, estimated_credit_usd
ZoomerLabs, org-783, 512000, 102.40
AcmeCorp, org-112, 180000, 36.00
BetaSoft, org-999, 42000, 8.40
... (rest omitted)
```
morgan: decision: apply automated credits for orgs where credit > $25, manual review for 25>= <=100, escalate >$100 to finance. billing-eng please apply credits for those above threshold and mark invoices on hold.
billing-eng: credits applied for orgs > $25. invoices placed on hold for affected windows.
customer-success: outreach drafts uploaded to CS drive, marking top impacted for phone outreach.
elaine: system stable. consumer commit lag down to baseline. scheduling unpause at +25m from now.
ops-oncall: unpaused emitter-42 at 7144441500. no new duplication observed.
morgan: closing action items: incident ticket #INC-2026-71444, postmortem assigned to samir (owner) and elaine (ops lead). timeline to be posted. initial customer credit and outreach in progress.
ryan: thumbs up. :thumbsup:
morgan: thanks everyone. will update when postmortem draft is ready.
customer-success: will follow up with CS notes once messages sent.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-71444 status transitioned to 'mitigated' at 7144441589.
